# Manual evaluation case

Status: blank worksheet, not an evaluated example. Copy outside the repository
before entering operating-profile details or permitted real evidence.

| Field | Value to record |
|---|---|
| Case / event family / domain | Stable identifiers |
| Split / registration digest | Assigned before reference drafting |
| Question / cutoff | Narrow institutional question; aware UTC timestamp |
| Rights decision | Eligible source-use record, or blocked |
| Evidence packet digest | Digest of the exact eligible input |
| Source / original origin | Distinguish publisher and original claimant |
| Publication / observation | Separate timestamps; no backdating |
| Available evidence | Identifiers and permitted references |
| Unavailable evidence | Identifier, reason and temporal boundary |
| Reference answer | Attributed claims, alternatives, counterevidence and unknowns |
| Prohibited inference | Specific tempting conclusion not supported by the packet |
| Later outcome | Answer-only; excluded from analysis input |
| Reviewer / reviewed at | Actual human reviewer and review timestamp |

## Review

For attribution, entailment, stage, counterevidence, independence, time and
uncertainty: record pass, fail or not-assessable, a reason and the evidence ID.
Record corrections and measured review duration separately. Preserve the original
draft. Leave results unfilled until review; no default passing values.
